pages.title: Start the hunt
pages.text: Craft one of the three offerings (recipes below). Right-click the top of solid ground with two clear blocks above it. Placement activates it immediately and consumes one item in survival. Invalid placement consumes nothing.

pages.title: Patience
pages.text: Wait about120–180 seconds of running game time. Weak particles appear first. After a minute, branches, footsteps or wings become audible; signals intensify in the final20 seconds. There is no permanent screen timer.

pages.title: Leshen
pages.text: Use a dense forest in the Overworld, at night or in deep shade. Keep clear ground and space around the crown: branches, trunks and leaves can prevent a safe encounter.

pages.title: Fiend
pages.text: Use forest habitat or fiend wilderness in the Overworld. A broad clearing and firm ground are important: this large beast cannot appear safely among tightly packed trees or over lava.

pages.title: Griffin
pages.text: Use open mountain habitat at Y80 or higher, with clear sky and room for wings and landing. Roofs, narrow ledges and obstructed flight space can prevent the encounter.

pages.title: Stay nearby
pages.text: Stay alive, in the same dimension and within64 blocks of the offering. If you leave, die, log out or unload its chunk, completion waits. Returning allows it to finish; the saved deadline is not rerolled. Whole-world shutdown does not advance game time.

pages.title: A safe approach
pages.text: The search checks loaded positions32–48 blocks from the lure, no more than8 blocks above/below it. A new boss stays at least24 blocks from every player and avoids their immediate view. No chunks are forced to load, no terrain is destroyed.

pages.title: Existing monsters
pages.text: A suitable nearby beast within96 blocks can be attracted instead of creating a clone. Busy beasts keep their combat target; a ground beast must have a usable path. Flight/landing for a flying Griffin uses its existing controller.

pages.title: Cancellation and return
pages.text: If habitat/support becomes invalid or no safe approach is found, the hunt is cancelled and one offering is dropped at the lure. Pick it up and try a better site. This is final cancellation, not an ongoing search. Breaking a pending lure also returns it once.

pages.title: Success and saved state
pages.text: Success consumes the offering permanently. Saved reservation IDs prevent duplicate bosses or refunds after reload. A later naturally spawned monster is not proof that a cancelled offering remained active.

pages.title: One hunting ground
pages.text: One active offering per hunter. Other active or recently successful hunts reserve a horizontal192-block area. A successful hunt starts a24000-game-tick cooldown (about20 running minutes) for owner and area. Cancellation does not start this success cooldown.
